forms.name: Household survey
forms.description: Registers a household and its members: district, block and village from your village list, head of household, main income, land, and each member's sex and age, with GPS and a photo. Adds the household and its members to the 'households' and 'members' lists for follow-up forms.

forms.name: Household visit
forms.description: A follow-up visit to a household already on the list: pick district, block, village and household, then record who was home, main income now, notes, and a new phone number if it changed (updates the household list).

forms.name: Livestock mortality (demo)
forms.description: Demo of need-to-have vs nice-to-have data. Pick a household, give its herd size, then add each animal that died: animal, date and cause are required; sex, age and a photo are optional. The dashboard shows deaths, mortality rate, causes, animals and months.
